alerts.title: Weight Gain on TLD
alerts.message: Guidelines suggest discussing weight gain possibility when starting ART. Patient has gained significant weight since starting TLD, with a current BMI of 32.4 kg/m². Evidence for drug attribution includes the known effect of certain ART regimens on weight. However, non-drug causes such as diet and exercise should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor weight, provide diet and exercise advice
